metadata.title: SK Hynix seeks TSMC 3nm expertise as Micron steps up hiring

content.text:
SK Hynix is seeking engineers with experience in TSMC's 3nm process to develop customized high-bandwidth memory (HBM), while US rival Micron Technology is stepping up recruitment in South Korea to support its Asian expansion.
The article requires paid subscription.
